appearances.snippet: And out of nowhere, Kanye (Kanye West), who did actually help me design the BLEXIT logo in Chicago, he was getting an insane amount of pressure and told that he could not get involved in politics.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting shows Candace Owens walked back her initial claim that Kanye West created the BLEXIT logo and colors, saying instead that he gave design advice and introduced the actual designer. West said he introduced her to the person who made the logo and denied BLEXIT association. This supports limited design help but not direct authorship of the logo.

records.text: Charlie Kirk did not know that Erika Kirk was telling people she knew people in Kanye West's orbit when Kanye's BLEXIT-distancing tweet went out
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I was the closest person to Charlie (Charlie Kirk) while he was beginning to date Erika (Erika Kirk), okay? No one spent more time with him or spoke to him more. He did not know these things about Erika Kirk, or Erika Frantzve was the name at the time. We had no idea that she was telling people that she knew the people that were in Kanye's (Kanye West's) orbit when he sent that tweet out.

verification.notes: This is Candace Owens first-person assertion about Charlie Kirk private knowledge in 2018. Charlie is deceased and no contemporaneous communication or independent witness evidence was found in live research on 2026-08-24; the negative claim about what he knew cannot be independently established.

records.text: Candace Owens said Charlie Kirk stood beside her when she started BLEXIT
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Charlie (Charlie Kirk) always had my back, and I always had his. ... Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was right by my side when I started Blexit, obviously.

verification.notes: Owens’s primary memorial recording directly states that Kirk was by her side when she started BLEXIT. Contemporaneous reporting places the campaign’s launch at Turning Point USA’s October 2018 Young Black Leadership Summit, corroborating the organizational setting. This verifies the first-person support claim without expanding it into a claim that Kirk founded BLEXIT.
